scope: The 1935 historic Maryknoll House on its Stanley hilltop: main brick range, the paired projecting wings, central north glazed-tile porch, seaward verandahs and green tiled roofs around the open courtyard.

originalReview.notes: The image is byte-identical to photographer Chingleung’s native July 2010 Commons upload. The original page declares own work and PD-self. The image controls the north open courtyard, green roofs, paired chimneys and brick window grid.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the published Qualla photo, matched it to the original photographer’s public-domain grant and checked its exact bytes. Used only this photo and written architectural facts. Views with other licences, surrounding houses and architectural drawings were excluded.
